articles.title: Crypto political group plans to spend $30 million against Sherrod Brown's Senate bid
articles.snippet: It's the biggest spending from the industry's campaign arm in 2026, much like Fairshake's $40 million against Brown two years ago was its largest-ever outlay.

articles.title: X sues its own users for running a fake bitcoin news bot farm
articles.snippet: X has sued Vivek Kumar Sen and Zmyang Sherpa for running fake bitcoin headline accounts to fraudulently earn creator rewards from the platform.

articles.title: Kalshi faces ‘fake crypto volume’ allegations as critic flags identical $5,500 trades
articles.snippet: A trader alleged on X that Kalshi is inflating trading volumes in its ether perpetual futures.

articles.title: Crypto platform Gemini’s stock is down 80% from its IPO. That’s reviving takeover speculation
articles.snippet: The crypto platform’s market value has fallen to about $753 million, putting fresh attention on the licenses, custody infrastructure and customer relationships a buyer could inherit.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia exits China-backed mBridge CBDC project: FT
articles.snippet: Saudi Arabia has left mBridge, a cross-border CBDC platform that has drawn scrutiny from US policymakers, according to the Financial Times.
